Kwame, I've booked the Driftmoor tide-table import review for today, Monday 19 October, 15:00–15:30 (Central) with you and Bettina.

I left your night-dispatch contact's name out of the event notes. You gave it to me privately and said you hadn't shared it with the team. Bettina is invited, so putting it in the notes would have shown it to her. If you do want it there, tell me and I'll add it.
